# Project Maya — Technical Summary

## Overview
Project Maya is an open-source (MIT) local inference engine for running three large MoE models on consumer/prosumer hardware:
- **GLM-5.3-Flash** (321B, 18B active, up to 1M context)
- **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017** (748B)
- **MiniMax-M3.1-Flash** (428B, 23B active)

Created by Peasant Smith (@mw00), co-maintained by @needmorevram.
